简介: At just 17 years old, Mason Thames has established himself as a sought-after young talent. He is best known for his starring role opposite Ethan Hawke in the Universal Pictures feature THE BLACK PHONE, in which he played "Finney Blake," a shy but clever 13-year-old boy who's being held in a soundproof basement by a sadistic, masked killer (played by Hawke). THE BLACK PHONE was directed by Scott Derrickson and executive produced by Jason Blum of Blumhouse Productions. He will reprise his role in the upcoming sequel due for release on October 17, 2025.
